sloka: तस्य रूपं शरस्यासीत्विधूमज्वालमण्डलम् ।वनं दहिष्यतो घर्मे दावाग्नेरिव मूर्च्छतः ।। ७.२१.४३ ॥
transliteration: tasya rūpaṁ śarasyāsītvidhūmajvālamaṇḍalam ।vanaṁ dahiṣyato gharme dāvāgneriva mūrcchataḥ ।। 7.21.43 ॥

translations.english: The form of that arrow was a smokeless circle of flames, like a raging forest fire intensifying in summer, about to consume a forest.
